fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Pseudonymous user id; one row per randomized user.

fields.name: arm
fields.description: Randomized assignment: old_page = current pricing page (control), new_page = redesigned pricing page (variant). Users are randomized in consecutive pairs matched on device and prior sessions, one to each arm.

fields.name: is_variant
fields.description: 1 if arm = new_page, else 0. Numeric copy of arm for regression.

fields.name: assign_week
fields.description: Week of the 4-week test in which the user was first assigned.

fields.name: device
fields.description: Device of the first pricing-page visit.

fields.name: plan_tier
fields.description: Plan tier the user first viewed on the pricing page.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Billing region inferred from IP geolocation.

fields.name: user_type
fields.description: new = first site visit during the test; returning = seen before the test.

fields.name: prior_sessions
fields.description: Pre-period covariate: sessions in the 30 days before assignment.

fields.name: pages_viewed
fields.description: Pages viewed in the 28 days after assignment.

fields.name: trial_started
fields.description: Started a free trial within 28 days of assignment (yes / no).

fields.name: paid_converted
fields.description: Converted to a paid plan within 28 days of assignment (yes / no); only trial starters convert.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: Revenue per user in USD (first invoice) within 28 days; 0 for non-payers.

fields.name: days_to_convert
fields.description: Days from assignment to paid conversion; null for users who did not convert.

fields.name: retained_30d
fields.description: Active on day 30 after assignment (yes / no).

fields.name: pages_noise
fields.description: Helper: the part of pages_viewed prior_sessions does not explain; shared by the two users of a randomization pair.

fields.name: order_value
fields.description: Helper: the first-invoice value a paying user would book on the current page, USD.

fields.name: n_old_desktop
fields.description: Helper: running count of old_page desktop users.

fields.name: n_old_mobile
fields.description: Helper: running count of old_page mobile users.

fields.name: n_old_tablet
fields.description: Helper: running count of old_page tablet users.

fields.name: n_new_desktop
fields.description: Helper: running count of new_page desktop users.

fields.name: n_new_mobile
fields.description: Helper: running count of new_page mobile users.

fields.name: n_new_tablet
fields.description: Helper: running count of new_page tablet users.

fields.name: n_cell
fields.description: Helper: this user's position in its arm x device cell.

fields.name: p_trial
fields.description: Helper: the planted trial-start rate of this user's arm x device cell.

fields.name: n_trials_old
fields.description: Helper: running count of old_page trial starters.

fields.name: n_trials_new
fields.description: Helper: running count of new_page trial starters.

fields.name: p_retain
fields.description: Helper: this user's planted 30-day retention probability.

fields.name: retain_old
fields.description: Helper: running sum of p_retain over old_page users.

fields.name: retain_new
fields.description: Helper: running sum of p_retain over new_page users.

set_expr.n_cell: arm == "old_page" ? (device == "desktop" ? n_old_desktop : device == "mobile" ? n_old_mobile : n_old_tablet) : (device == "desktop" ? n_new_desktop : device == "mobile" ? n_new_mobile : n_new_tablet)

set_expr.retained_30d: (arm == "old_page" ? floor(retain_old) > floor(retain_old - p_retain) : floor(retain_new) > floor(retain_new - p_retain)) ? "yes" : "no"
